'''xcshort The Court Has Ruled You Are To Be Executed.''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[xcshort]]
* '''Published:''' 17 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Vile xcshort DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

First we hunt them then we take them to prison until Jabba, the Judge, rules on their fate.

== Strategy ==

The point of the deck is to say away from space except to control Nal Hutta.  The reason i am using bounty instead of Hutt Bounty is that Bounty can target more characters.  For the most part this deck relies on multiple ways to capture.  All Wrapped Up.  Bossk With Mortar Gun.  IG-88 With Riot Gun.  And Hidden Weapons.  All this deck is for is my own enjoyment of trying to capture characters.   I hope i did well
